description: A matched pair of glossy black hooks, sharp as the day they grew. Duskfang and its cousins do not give them up.
lore: Worn on a thong, a matched pair says one thing and says it loudly: I have stood in front of a [[monsters/saber_toothed_tiger|Duskfang]] and I am here to be asked about it.

A woman on the black-wood rounds wore hers for two years before she had earned them. She bought them, eight over the going rate, from a man who knew precisely what she was buying and handed them across without a word about it. She has since done the thing twice, properly, with people watching, which by any reckoning settles the account. She still will not take them off. The man is still on that road and still nods to her at the crossing, and in all the years since neither of them has said one syllable about it, and she has worked out by now that the nod is the part she cannot give up.
gm_notes: A lie that came true and went on costing anyway. The seller's silence is the relationship; neither of them will ever name it. Useful for a player who wants to buy credibility rather than earn it.
